  "situation": "A GS‑13 employee of the Department of Homeland Security has been close personal friends for many years with a neighbor who was a GS‑15 employee in another agency. During that friendship the GS‑13 employee allowed the neighbor's family to use a vacation house rent‑free. The neighbor recently accepted a position at the Department of Homeland Security and will serve as the GS‑13 employee's direct supervisor. The applicable ethics regulation permits a gift if a personal relationship justifies it and the recipient is not the official superior, or if the giver is the official superior. The regulation also states that a superior may not coerce a subordinate to offer a gift and that, during a supervisor‑subordinate relationship, the employee may not allow the supervisor to receive such a gift except as permitted by the exceptions.",
